title: Deliver close --comment specs, Python/Rust parity, and documentation
description:
## User story

As an AI agent closing a Kanbus task, I want `kbs close <id> --comment "..."` to record the closing note and close the task in one command, so the completion record and status transition stay together.

## Gherkin source of truth

Write shared executable scenarios before production code in the existing issue-close feature area. Run both behavior runners and capture their expected failure before implementation.

Scenarios must cover:
- success: normal comment is appended, status becomes `closed`, and `closed_at` is set;
- plain close: no comment and unchanged behavior;
- empty/whitespace comment: fails before any mutation;
- rejected close after a valid comment: comment remains and issue stays open;
- lifecycle order: comment before/after hooks complete before close before/after hooks;
- Beads-compatible project behavior;
- Python/Rust matching persisted state, events, output, and exit status.

## Implementation sequence

1. Add `--comment <text>` to Python Click and Rust Clap close commands.
2. Reuse normal comment behavior for validation, author, IDs, events, text-quality signals, hooks, and Beads compatibility.
3. Execute comment first, then close. Preserve normal close output only; do not introduce an extra success line.
4. Keep lower-level close domain functions status-transition-only; this is a CLI composite operation.
5. Keep `close <id>` without `--comment` behavior unchanged.
6. Ensure both binary help outputs expose the option.
7. Verify existing reference docs, getting-started content, web docs, and agent guidance describe the delivered canonical command; edit only where accuracy needs it.

## Required verification

Run focused behavior/unit tests, Python quality gates, Rust quality gates, and `python tools/check_spec_parity.py`. Provide command output or concise results in the final Kanbus comment.

## Delivery protocol

Work on a feature branch from `develop`; open a PR targeting `develop`. Record milestone comments with:

`Progress: …`
`Evidence: …`
`Next: …`
`Risk/Blocker: …`

Use Codex provenance on all comments. Close this story only after the PR-ready implementation has all specified checks green and the final comment records commit/PR plus exact verification commands.
